Each clip is one Bible verse that was cut automatically from a full chapter recording. Listen to the whole clip while reading the transcript, and choose the option that best describes whether the spoken words match the written words.

  • EXTRA: you hear words that are not in the transcript (for example part of the previous or next verse, or a chapter number or section title read aloud).
  • MISSING: words in the transcript are not heard, or the first or last word is cut off so it cannot be understood.

Please ignore voice quality, accent, speed, breaths and background noise. Punctuation is not spoken, and numbers written as digits may be read out as words; neither counts as a mismatch.

If you choose one of the last three options, please also say where the problem is (required) and, if you can, write the extra or missing words (optional).
